data.name: Bioenergie Frauenfeld
data.description: Bioenergie Frauenfeld AG is a Swiss wood CHP plant operator jointly owned by Energie 360° AG and Schweizer Zucker AG, operating one of the world's largest SynCraft pyrolysis-based wood gasification plants in Frauenfeld, Thurgau. The 4 MW plant processes ~25,000 tonnes of residual wood annually into electricity for ~8,000 households, heat for the adjacent sugar factory and district heating, plus biochar as a third product. Biochar/CDR is an adjacent revenue stream to the core energy generation business.
